ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Across 205 occurrences in 116 allowlisted texts, Chan masters pair it with “each thing and each particular” (物物頭頭), say that every mote and land “fully displays” (全彰), and place it in public addresses as the range of an action or disclosure.
EvidenceBody: One address says, “every mote and every land once manifested awe-inspiring light; each thing and each particular fully displayed the true eye” (塵塵剎剎，曾現威光。物物頭頭，全彰正眼). Another gives the compact parallel, “each thing and each particular—the whole body; every mote and every land—the great function” (物物頭頭全身，塵塵剎剎大用). The phrase is also made a test: “if you understand, every mote and every land; if you do not, a kick to the head” (若也會得，塵塵剎剎；若也不會，當頭一蹋). The corpus thus bends a cosmological distributive into recurring teaching-seat language for an all-pervading range; this entry makes no claim beyond those deployments.
